subject: Urgent: Elevated 5xx/429 errors impacting GreenTech - suspected retry storm
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@greentech.io>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: greentech-support@greentech.io
Date: Sat, 14 Mar 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Elevated 5xx/429 spikes this morning — urgent

Hi Marissa,

We started seeing large numbers of 5xx and 429 responses to our Redwood requests around 07:45 PST this morning. Latency jumped from ~120ms to >1s and throughput dropped by ~60%. Our app is experiencing timeouts and retry loops are making client-side queues back up. We've attached a short trace and a heatmap from our observability.

What we need: immediate guidance on whether this is on our side or Redwood's, and an urgent mitigation plan. Our mobile users are affected and leadership is asking for a status update.

Attachments: debug_snapshot_20260314.log (text/plain), error_heatmap_20260314.png (image/png)

Thanks,
Samira
Head of Platform
GreenTech Analytics
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@greentech.io>
Cc: monica.patel@redwoodinference.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sat, 14 Mar 2026 08:40:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Elevated 5xx/429 spikes this morning — urgent

Samira — thanks for the heads up and the logs. We're treating this as P1. I’ve looped in Monica (CS) and Vivek (infra). Initial ask: can you confirm SDK version and whether you’ve recently changed retry/backoff config?

Immediate next steps from our side:
- Vivek will look at our serving telemetry and correlate the time window.
- Monica will coordinate a short troubleshooting call.
- If we confirm a retry storm, we’ll provide a temporary mitigation (circuit breaker or rate-limit rules) you can apply while we fix the root cause.

I’ll update you in 30 minutes.

— Marissa
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, monica.patel@redwoodinference.com
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sat, 14 Mar 2026 09:05:34 -0700
Subject: Re: Elevated 5xx/429 spikes this morning — suspected retry loops

Quick findings from our infra side after correlating traces and ingestion metrics:

- Start time of spike: ~07:43 PST.
- Error profile: ~70% 429s, ~20% 5xx (502/503), increased timeouts during token exchange.
- Correlation: a large volume of short-interval retries from GreenTech IP blocks. Traces show the same client requests retried dozens of times within seconds.

Preliminary hypothesis: customer-side retry/backoff logic (or SDK default) is configured for aggressive retries with minimal or no exponential backoff, which turned transient rate-limited responses into a retry storm. This overwhelms our front-end queues and pushes downstream overloads, producing 5xx responses.

Immediate mitigations we can propose:
- Recommend GreenTech temporarily disable client retries or set a strict circuit-breaker for 30s when sequential 429s occur.
- We can push a per-customer throttling rule (soft-shaper) for ~2 minutes to let queues drain.
- Rotate a fallback model pool to reduce pressure on the primary nodes.

I attached a trimmed server-side trace and a JSON of sampled SDK traces we captured (sdk_trace_greentech.json). I’ll open JIRA INF-8421 for a production fix and an SDK change to make backoff safer by default.

Attachments: sdk_trace_greentech.json

— Vivek
Senior Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@greentech.io>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sat, 14 Mar 2026 09:15:22 -0700
Subject: Re: Elevated 5xx/429 spikes this morning — action plan and remediation steps

Samira — Monica from CS here. We can do a 15-minute call right now to walk through a temporary mitigation. Suggested immediate steps you can apply on your side:

1) Stop outgoing client retries (toggle in SDK) or set retries=0.
2) If toggling is not possible, increase backoff to exponential with base 500ms and jitter, and reduce max retries to 1-2.
3) Add a client-side circuit breaker that trips after 5 sequential 429/5xx responses for 30s.

If you confirm you can apply step 1, we’ll also apply a soft-shaper on our edge for your account for 2 minutes while we monitor the queue drain.

Call invite: (placeholder) https://meet.redwood.com/greentech-incident

— Monica
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@greentech.io>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: greentech-support@greentech.io
Date: Sat, 14 Mar 2026 09:28:49 -0700
Subject: Re: Elevated 5xx/429 spikes this morning — action plan and remediation steps

Monica/Vivek — I can confirm we are on SDK v1.2.0 and do not have exponential backoff enabled by default in our config (we assumed the SDK would handle sensible backoff). Our retry count is currently 5 and backing off linearly at 200ms.

We will:
- Disable retries immediately and deploy a quick rollback config in the next 10 minutes.
- Share a short log after the change.

Longer term, two asks from our side: 1) can Redwood publish a recommended client retry config in your docs for SDK v1.x, and 2) can you open a ticket to change the SDK default to exponential jittered backoff?

Thanks — Samira
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: exec-team@redwoodinference.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sat, 14 Mar 2026 11:02:10 -0700
Subject: Exec: GreenTech incident summary and recommended customer remediation/comp credit

Folks — quick summary of the GreenTech outage window this morning (P1):
- Impact: client-facing timeouts and an increase in 5xx/429s during ~07:43–08:15 PST.
- Root cause: retry storm exacerbated by RSI (customer SDK config defaulting to aggressive retries without exponential backoff) + sudden traffic pattern.
- Status: customer applied disable-retries within 10 minutes; errors trended back down after soft-shaper and SDK config change.

Recommended next steps:
1) Offer a goodwill credit for the impacted window (recommendation: one week of usage credits for GreenTech).
2) Prioritize JIRA INF-8421 to change SDK defaults to exponential jittered backoff and lower retry ceiling.
3) Publish a best-practices doc for retry/backoff on the developer docs site and notify customers who use SDK v1.x.

Marissa/Rishi — please coordinate the credit and customer comms. Vivek — estimate ETA for SDK patch; we want a roadmap item with a target by EOW.

— Markus
VP, Commercial Operations, Redwood Inference
